title: Prospective Evaluation of Disparities in Provision of Allogeneic Transplantation
official: Prospective Evaluation of Disparities in Provision of Allogeneic Transplantation
summary: To look at the effect of a recipient's ancestry and socio-economic status on their choice of bone marrow transplantation donor cells and their chance of receiving genetically similar (allogeneic) bone marrow cells versus cells that are not genetically similar (allograft).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. ≥ 18 years of age.
2. Candidate for allogeneic transplantation

Exclusion Criteria:

1\) Allogeneic stem cell transplantation not medically indicated.
